title: Dual preserves fan-in at most two
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct arguments, whose NOT gates have exactly one argument, and whose gates have at most two arguments. If the dual circuit is formed by swapping AND and OR gates while leaving NOT gates and all arguments unchanged, then it also has pairwise distinct gate arguments, exactly one argument at each NOT gate, and at most two arguments at every gate.
hypotheses_covered: C has distinct arguments at each gate
Each NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
